title: Street Dog vs Restaurant Boy
text: We stayed the night in Bamei (3,500 m) to acclimatise before continuing on to Tagong (3,700 m). While we were having dinner at a noodle shop, the owner’s son was playing with a very patient street dog. After comparing their missing teeth, the two of them held a contest to see who could balance a bottle cap on their head the longest. The dog won easily.
